question.text: Under the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008, what measures can the designated authority recommend after an enquiry?

answer.text: Only issuance of a regulatory censure
Only cancellation or suspension of the certificate of registration
Only prohibition from taking new assignments or debarment of officers

Cancellation or suspension of the certificate of registration; prohibition from new assignments and debarment of officers or branch offices; issuance of a regulatory censure; or disposal of proceedings without adverse action

explanation.text: The Logic: The designated authority may recommend cancellation or suspension of the certificate of registration, prohibition from new assignments, debarment of officers or branch offices, issuance of a regulatory censure, or disposal of proceedings without any adverse action. The list is enumerated together in the regulation. The Trap: Each narrower option names a real measure but only a single slice of the available toolkit. The regulation explicitly provides the full set, ranging from no adverse action to suspension or cancellation of registration. Note: Rewrote the keyed option as a standalone enumerated list (no "All of the above") so it remains correct under answer randomization, and removed the unsourced reputation/business-prospect pro-tip and the cross-exam paragraph.
